scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Do not forget
that the Holy War
is fast approaching!
We must ready ourselves!
May the light of justice
always brighten our path!
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
别忘了，圣战迫在眉睫！
我们必须做好准备！
愿正义之光永远照亮我们的道路！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
The Holy War will
be upon us before we
know it. More than ever,
we have need of strong men
and women to fight for what
is good and right.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
圣战转眼就会降临。
我们比以往任何时候，都更需要强大的战士，为善良与正义而战。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Will you fight on
the side of righteousness
as a Paladin?
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
你愿意成为圣殿十字军，为正义而战吗？

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Congratulations.
As a Paladin, I hope
you will protect those
weaker than you, and bring
us victory in the upcoming
war between good and evil.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
恭喜。
愿你身为圣殿十字军，保护弱者，在即将到来的正邪之战中为我们赢得胜利。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
在这里安心休息吧。
向战士们致敬！
